fragmentationClusters.title: Event card, listing row and rail cards
fragmentationClusters.decision: Shared media, title, metadata and status primitives; keep distinct layout APIs for list, rail and discovery contexts.

fragmentationClusters.title: Mobile bottom navigation, search navigation and mobile menu
fragmentationClusters.decision: Shared navigation item and active-state tokens; keep menu overlay separate from persistent bottom navigation.

fragmentationClusters.title: Persistent notices and timed toasts
fragmentationClusters.decision: Share semantic tones and anatomy; lifecycle, dismissal and announcement semantics remain separate.

fragmentationClusters.title: Rail and bus schedules
fragmentationClusters.decision: Extract shared schedule row and service state, retain mode-specific route metadata and iconography.

fragmentationClusters.title: Wide, narrow and absent event media
fragmentationClusters.decision: One EventHero family with explicit media geometry and viewport variants.

fragmentationClusters.title: Focus-group invite, NPS and feedback
fragmentationClusters.decision: One product flow composed of separate steps; do not merge the forms into one generic component.

designGaps.title: Attach accepted production release identity
designGaps.requirement: Replace implementation-main source mode with exact static-release-manifest, build ID and snapshot evidence.

designGaps.title: Generate multi-resolution actual / baseline / diff evidence
designGaps.requirement: Populate pages 90–93 from automated tests at the accepted production SHA.

designGaps.title: Connect editorial contracts to component APIs
designGaps.requirement: Show title-length, date, venue, price, status, alt and credit rules beside the components that consume them.

designGaps.title: Brand extensions for print, email and social
designGaps.requirement: Keep shared foundations while documenting channel-specific templates and constraints.
